elements.description:
A form that creates or edits a routine – name, frequency and start time in a time zone with the next run worked out,
first run now or on schedule, email notifications and instructions, with Dismiss and Create routine.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading; by default "Create a routine", or "Edit routine" in edit mode

properties.name: description
properties.description: The line under the heading, before the Routines link; by default the labels' description

properties.name: value
properties.description: The form's contents. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: mode
properties.description: "create" for a new routine, "edit" for one that exists – it names the heading and the main button

properties.name: routinesHref
properties.description: Where the Routines link in the description goes; without it, the link is a button that fires tc-open-routines

properties.name: timeZone
properties.description: The routine's time zone, an IANA name such as "America/Los_Angeles"; by default the browser's

properties.name: now
properties.description: The time now, epoch ms, for the next run; by default the element's own clock

properties.name: busy
properties.description: While the page saves the routine: the buttons wait and the main one says "Creating…"

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for days and times, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: labels
properties.description: The form's words, merged over defaultRoutineLabels

properties.name: nextRun
properties.description: The next scheduled run, epoch ms

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: A field changed ({ value }: RoutineValueChange); cancelable – prevented, `value` stays as it was

events.name: tc-submit
events.description: Create routine (Save routine when editing) was pressed with the name and instructions filled in ({ value, nextRun }: RoutineSubmit); cancelable – prevented, nothing is announced

events.name: tc-open-routines
events.description: The Routines link in the description was used ({ href }: RoutineOpenRoutines); cancelable – prevented, the link doesn't open

functions.name: emptyRoutine
functions.description: A new routine: weekly on Monday at 9:00, the first run on schedule, an email when a run finds something

functions.name: nextRoutineRuns
functions.signature: nextRoutineRuns(schedule: RoutineSchedule, now: number, count: unknown, timeZone?: string): number[]
functions.description:
The next `count` runs (epoch ms) of a schedule after `now`, with the time read in `timeZone` (an IANA name, e.g.
"America/Los_Angeles"; the browser's by default). Empty when the time can't be read.

functions.name: nextRoutineRun
functions.signature: nextRoutineRun(schedule: RoutineSchedule, now: number, timeZone?: string): number | null
functions.description: The next run (epoch ms) of a schedule after `now`, in `timeZone`; null when it can't be worked out

props.name: title
props.description: The heading; by default "Create a routine", or "Edit routine" in edit mode

props.name: value
props.description: The form's contents – controlled when given

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The contents on mount when `value` isn't controlled; by default an empty weekly routine

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: A field changed; `next` is the whole draft

props.name: onCreate
props.type: (value: RoutineDraft, nextRun: number | null) => void | false
props.description: Create routine (or Save routine) was pressed with the form filled in; return false to skip the announcement

props.name: onOpenRoutines
props.description: The Routines link was used; return false to keep its link from opening

changelog: **Routine Form** (`tc-routine-form`): set up a scheduled routine – name, frequency, start time in a time zone with the next run worked out (DST-safe, `nextRoutineRun()` exported), first run now or on schedule, email notifications and instructions, with validation and Create / Save.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: field-sizing
features.without: Text fields grow with their text. Without it they keep their minimum height and scroll.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: @property
features.without: The registered custom properties don't interpolate, so the transitions and spins they drive jump to their end state.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
